weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. At start of turn, if any foes have the highest Atk, Spd, Def, or Res on the enemy team, inflicts -6 on those foes' corresponding stat through their next action.

assist.d:
Grants another action to target ally.
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance.)

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Spd+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Spd/Res+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Spd/Res+4 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Spd+7, Res+10 during combat and foe cannot make a follow-up attack.

b.d: If Sing or Dance is used, grants Atk+2 to target.
If Sing or Dance is used, grants Atk/Spd+2 to target.
If Sing or Dance is used, grants Atk/Spd+3 to target.

c.d: Inflicts Atk/Spd-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
